build_upscale_pipeline: build an ONNX Stable Diffusion upscale pipeline with VAE, UNet, text encoder, and schedulers
run_image_upscaling: run the ONNX upscale pipeline to generate high-res images from a low-res image and prompt
preprocess_images: preprocess PIL images by resizing to 64-pixel multiples and normalizing to a torch tensor
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode text prompts into CLIP text embeddings with optional negative prompt support
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent tensors back to pixel-space images using the VAE model
